# scrapling (vendored)

This is a vendored copy of [scrapling](https://github.com/D4Vinci/Scrapling)
v0.3.9 (cycle-five fork at d3614fcd) for use as a dependency of `gamba_pick`.
It's pinned to a known-good revision rather than installed from PyPI / git
directly so that customer installs are reproducible without external network
access to the Scrapling repository.
